bifrost: bifrost_app::webview (springboard/sdk/src/webview.rs), bifrost_app::webview_dev (springboard/sdk/src/webview_dev.rs), springboard/apps/browser/ (Browser app), springboard/ui/src/web_auth.rs (shared-login session model)
summary: BifrOSt has a WebKit-style web view for SDK apps (WebProcessPool over the Servo engine) and a full Browser app with tabs, history, bookmarks, reader mode and private windows. It has a shared-login session model that no shell code drives yet, but no Safari extension, content blocker, Reading List, universal link, or standard in-app Safari sheet API.

features.apple: Safari Services landing (web content in your app); SFSafariViewController is the Safari-owned variant
features.note: Load, navigation, state and events exist. No hover, drag selection, context menus, select/file panels, or cancel of a load (Servo 0.7.0 limits).

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 4 (w4-safari-services, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. An SDK app has to build its own web view and chrome. No system-provided browser sheet with Safari's controls.

features.feature: Safari web extensions and Safari app extensions
features.apple: SFSafariExtension, SFSafariExtensionHandler, SFSafariExtensionManager, SFSafariPage, SFSafariTab, SFSafariWindow, SFExtensionMessageKey, Web Inspector extensions
features.note: Pure model: permissions, enable state, and a request and reply exchange between a page and an extension that is refused unless the extension is enabled for that page URL and only the extension that got a request can answer it (parity_sdk-complete-47.rs). Gap: no extension host, no page or tab proxies, and no transport between the browser and an extension process; not wired into the shell or apps, not tested on Midget. The browser has no plug-in API.

features.apple: SFContentBlockerManager, SFContentBlockerState, creating a content blocker
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 5 tests. Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No content-blocking rules API and no ad or tracker blocking.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 5 tests. Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Reader mode exists in springboard/src/shell/browser/reader.rs, but it has no saved list and no SDK API.

features.apple: SFAuthenticationSession (deprecated) and its completion handler, SFAuthenticationError
features.note: Pure session model: start URL and callback validation, the single completion, cancel, presentation failure, the router that gives each redirect to one session, and headers. Headless tests in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-04.rs. Gap: not wired into the shell or apps, and nothing shares a one-time login between the browser and apps (needs the browser profile on the lab machine). The Apple successor (ASWebAuthenticationSession) is not in this framework.

features.apple: SFUniversalLink, applinks service, Associated Domains Entitlement
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 5 tests. Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No mapping from a website to an installed app and no link handoff. Apps cannot claim web domains.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 4 (theme-23, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Preferences are private to the Browser app. Other apps cannot read them and there is no system-wide Safari settings object.

features.feature: Browser app features (history, bookmarks, tabs, private windows)
features.apple: Safari app (not in the framework; the framework exposes only the extension-side proxies)
features.note: History capped at 5000 with private windows kept out, frecency-ranked address suggestions and bookmarks are tested in suggest::tests (bookmarks_first_then_frecent_history_then_search, history_dedupes_caps_and_skips_non_web, serialization_round_trips) and store::bookmark_tests and store::import_tests. Session restore and reader mode exist in the app but are not covered by these tests. Those are app-level, not SDK API, and there is no History or Bookmarks menu API.

features.apple: Adding a web development tool to Safari Web Inspector; Creating Safari Web Inspector extensions
features.note: Script evaluation, screenshots and input exist for the Browser's own inspector. There is no public extension point for adding a tool to it.

features.apple: Importing data exported from Safari (bookmarks, saved passwords)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 4 (w4-safari-services, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No import path for Safari bookmarks or passwords. Browser bookmarks are stored as TSV under ~/.local/share/bifrost-browser/.

features.feature: Home Screen bookmarks and availability checks
features.note: Home Screen bookmarks are an iOS feature. The availability and version checks depend on Apple's Safari Services versions and have no BifrOSt counterpart.

gaps: No standard in-app browser sheet (SFSafariViewController equivalent) for SDK apps
No content-blocking rules API and no ad or tracker blocking
No Safari Reading List (SSReadingList) or Reading List share target
No web extension host, Safari page or tab proxies, or extension messaging
No universal links or associated-domain lookup for apps
No shared login between the browser and apps: the session model exists but the shell does not drive it yet
Browser preferences (SFSafariSettings) are private to the Browser app, with no system-wide object
Web view input and rendering gaps: no hover, drag selection, context menus, select or file panels, or load cancel (docs/bifrost-ui.md 'Web view')
